title: Claude vs ChatGPT for Coding in 2026: Which AI Writes Better Code?
summary: Claude vs ChatGPT for coding in 2026: honest benchmark comparison across real tasks, pricing, and which to use for building apps vs general coding.
body_markdown: For complex coding tasks — large refactors, multi-file features, autonomous execution — Claude 4.6 Sonnet outperforms GPT-5.2 on benchmark and in practice. For quick snippets and common patterns, both are excellent. The gap is most visible when you're giving Claude Code or an agent a complex multi-step task.
